indicators: Sending mail from suspicious domain 'fakecorp-payrnents.com' with homoglyph domain name
Email with attachment named 'Invoice_INV-457812.pdf' sent from unexpected external sender
SPF pass but domain is newly registered (created 2023-03-15) and uses WhoisGuard privacy
URL containing JWT token used as a query parameter in phishing URL
SMTP transaction logs show mail originated from 198.51.100.23, an unrecognized outbound mail server
Phishing page HTTP response contains a login form posting credentials to /authenticate
examples.detection_method: Use of threat intelligence to flag newly registered lookalike domains with homoglyphs in corporate email recipients; email gateway analysis of attachment names and sender address reputation; URL scanning and sandboxing of links containing JWT tokens; heuristic detection of login forms served from non-corporate domains; user education to verify invoice requests via secondary communication channels; monitoring SMTP logs for unusual mail servers sending to C-level executives; implementation of DMARC with strict policies.
